product.title: Barcelona Premium: Gothic, Montjuic, Sagrada Familia & Park Güell

description.text: Cover the best of Barcelona on this full-day tour. Visit the city’s most famous attractions and landmarks such as the Gothic Quarter, Plaza Catalunya, Montjuic and more as you learn about Barcelona’s history from your informative guide. Stops include Gothic Quarter, Montjuïc, Sagrada Familia, Park Güell. This comprehensive tour also visits two popular attractions: Sagrada Familia and Park Guell. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
